item.title: The lights are still here?, 2nd November
item.description:
What is happening with the temporary traffic lights at the T-junction please? They have been there, creating backed up traffic in every direction, for a very long time. Ironically whenever they have broken the traffic has flowed 10X better. Every date for completion on the Glos Roadways page has not been met. How much longer is this going to continue?
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 68, Church Road, Kingsditch, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.description:
